surfaces.says: The Evry panel the Ask Evry button opens beside any page: ask in words and see what Evry read as cards of linked rows. Each person has their own conversations. The catalog endpoint is listed for completeness: nothing in the app calls it, so no step reaches it.

expect.name: List the people in this church

behaviors.says: A question runs one turn in the signed-in person's own conversation; what Evry read comes back as a card of linked rows from this church only.

tests.name: AC:UI45-001 AC:UI45-002 AC:INH-REGRESSION-SESSION-NAVIGATION AC:EVRY-RETRY-CANCEL AC:INH-CROSS-08 one private conversation, one turn per request key, one active run, cancel and explicit retry
AC:INH-REGRESSION-FOREIGN-SESSION AC:TEN-002 AC:SEC-02 AC:UI45-006 INV-tenancy: another account or context cannot read, stream, append, cancel or continue a conversation

click.name: List the people in this church

behaviors.says: Stop ends a running turn and keeps what was written; Try again reruns only the last turn that did not finish, and a change that did not confirm can be retried once.

tests.name: AC:UI45-001 AC:UI45-002 AC:INH-REGRESSION-SESSION-NAVIGATION AC:EVRY-RETRY-CANCEL AC:INH-CROSS-08 one private conversation, one turn per request key, one active run, cancel and explicit retry
INV-stream-stop INV-stream-end: Stop keeps the partial text and ends the stream promptly
INV-effect-recovery: an approved effect that no worker took within 60 s reads as unconfirmed, not as saving; Try again's job is claimed first and runs it once

behaviors.says: A moved seat's old-church sends, retries, streams and opens are refused with Reload.

tests.name: INV-church-changed: a seat moved to another church refuses the old church's conversation as church_changed and writes nothing
INV-church-changed: a moved seat's retry or read of the old conversation is church_changed

behaviors.says: An Owner or Admin attaches a Word or text file in the panel and asks for a church document: Evry shows a review of the import, refuses any file the Documents import refuses with that import's own sentence, and the document is in Documents only after Approve.

tests.name: AC:CASE-DOC-016 AC:GAP-EVR-422 an attached Word file becomes a church document through one review: nothing is in Documents until Approve, then one document with the file's headings and paragraphs, however often it is approved or retried
AC:CASE-DOC-016 a file larger than the import limit is refused with the import's size message and nothing is written

surfaces.says: A change Evry prepared, shown in the panel as Review before saving with the exact old and new values: Approve runs it once, Revise replaces it, Cancel ends it. Nothing changes until you approve.

expect.name: List the people in this church

behaviors.says: After a seat moves church, Approve on the old church's change is refused and it stays pending; the card says the church changed and offers Reload.

tests.name: INV-church-changed: approving the old church's pending proposal after the seat moves church is refused as church_changed and changes nothing

behaviors.says: A change Evry prepares shows as Review before saving with the exact old and new values; Approve runs it once and the page it changed shows the new value.

tests.name: AC:UI45-004 AC:UI45-003 AC:INH-REGRESSION-REVISED-APPROVAL AC:INH-REGRESSION-TEMPLATE-EDIT AC:INH-REGRESSION-CONFIRM-REPLAY AC:UI45-005 AC:AUDIT-002 INV-budget: nothing changes until the exact current revision is approved; then the change runs once with its own audit row
AC:INH-REGRESSION-CONFIRM-REPLAY INV-approve-runs-once: a first approval saves its change without any other request; its replay saves nothing again

behaviors.says: Revise replaces the prepared change and voids the earlier approval; Cancel ends it with nothing saved.

tests.name: AC:UI45-002 AC:INH-REGRESSION-CONFIRM-REPLAY INV-lost-approval: a revised change saves once (${engine})

AC:UI45-004 AC:UI45-003 AC:INH-REGRESSION-REVISED-APPROVAL AC:INH-REGRESSION-TEMPLATE-EDIT AC:INH-REGRESSION-CONFIRM-REPLAY AC:UI45-005 AC:AUDIT-002 INV-budget: nothing changes until the exact current revision is approved; then the change runs once with its own audit row
AC:INH-REGRESSION-EXPIRED-APPROVAL AC:UI45-004 AC:SEC-12 an approval at or after expiry, even one that lapses while the effect waits, or a cancelled one, starts nothing

behaviors.says: A photo attached in the panel's one attach control is staged privately in that conversation; a People photo review shows it only to its owner while the review lasts, approval needs it, and the approved photo is bound to one person once.

tests.name: AC:UI45-003 a photo proposal's owner sees the exact attached photo while the review lasts; approval needs it
an Owner's attached photo becomes Priya's People photo only after Approve, and the effect runs once

behaviors.noOperation: the panel stages the photo as a conversation attachment (packages/evry/src/attachments/store.ts) and, for the user's own account photo, through the Settings avatar upload (conversation/photoActions.ts); the review card reads it back from packages/evry/src/proposals/store.ts; none is an Evry catalog operation
